items.text:
`harbor build` now skips pages that haven't changed. On the sample site the first build reports `built 3 pages` and a second one `built 0 pages`.

- **`cache.go`** stores a SHA-256 of each page's source and the templates in `public/.harbor-cache.json`.
- **`build.go`** no longer deletes `public/`; it renders a page only when its hash changed. Editing any template rebuilds every page.
- **`main.go`** adds `harbor build -force`, which ignores the cache.

One gap: deleting a source page leaves its old HTML in `public/`. Want me to remove outputs whose source is gone?
